facts.text: A stormy, desolate terrestrial planet in orbit of the sun Lotho, Lotho Minor was located beyond the Western Reaches in the Lotho Minor system, which itself was located in the northern part of the Outer Rim Territories' Wazta sector, in grid square I-17 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

evidence.quote: A stormy, desolate terrestrial planet in orbit of the sun Lotho, Lotho Minor was located beyond the Western Reaches in the Lotho Minor system, which itself was located in the northern part of the Outer Rim Territories' Wazta sector, in grid square I-17 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

facts.text: Lotho Minor had a brownish surface covered with enormous mountains of trash piled over countless generations, with much of it permanently on fire, and had more junk than even the planet Raxus Prime.

facts.text: Maul had a lair located in a cave beneath the surface of the planet Lotho Minor. After his defeat at the hands of Obi-Wan Kenobi, Maul lived in a cave that he made into his lair on the junk world of Lotho Minor until his brother Savage Opress found him.
